title: Pairing AIS with RF: Analysis of a Markovian Approach for Maritime Data Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.18563v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Monitoring maritime activities is important for safety and security, particularly for detecting illegal activities, but remains challenging due to the size and complexity of the maritime domain. The Automatic Identification System (AIS) is commonly used for this purpose, despite its known vulnerabilities. In contrast, space-based radio frequency (RF) observations provide an independent source of vessel activity but lack ship identification and therefore cannot identify vessels on their own. Following the CRISP-DM process, this study applies a Pair Hidden Markov Model (PHMM) to align individual RF detections with AIS trajectories, using temporal and spatial information while modeling noise and timing discrepancies. We evaluate it on NOAA AIS data with synthetic RF detections against nearest-neighbor baselines and analyze its errors with bias tests on trajectory length, sampling density, stationarity and AIS--RF distance. translated_title: AIS与射频配对：海上数据融合的马尔可夫方法分析
translated_abstract: 监测海上活动对于安全与保障至关重要，特别是在检测非法活动方面，但由于海上领域的规模和复杂性，这项工作仍然充满挑战。船舶自动识别系统（AIS）通常被用于这一目的，尽管它存在已知的漏洞。相比之下，天基射频（RF）观测提供了船舶活动的独立数据来源，但缺乏船舶身份信息，因此无法独立识别船舶。本研究遵循CRISP-DM流程，应用配对隐马尔可夫模型（PHMM）将单个射频检测结果与AIS轨迹进行对齐，在利用时间和空间信息的同时对噪声和时间偏差进行建模。我们在NOAA AIS数据上结合合成射频检测结果对该方法进行评估，并与最近邻基线方法进行对比，同时通过对轨迹长度、采样密度、平稳性以及AIS-RF距离的偏差测试来分析其误差。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于配对隐马尔可夫模型（PHMM）的马尔可夫方法，将天基射频检测结果与AIS船舶轨迹进行时空对齐，从而克服AIS系统的安全漏洞与射频观测无法识别船舶的局限，实现有效的海上多源数据融合。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Pair Hidden Markov Model (PHMM) approach to align space-based RF detections with AIS vessel trajectories using temporal and spatial information, overcoming AIS vulnerabilities and RF's lack of ship identification for effective maritime data fusion.
